name: @avel/server
description: AVEL's backend: one Hono service with oRPC and Effect inside (Step 1).

scripts.check:effect: sh -c 'if [ "$1" = -- ]; then shift; fi; if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then effect-tsgo diagnostics --project "$PWD/tsconfig.json"; else s=0; for f in "$@"; do effect-tsgo diagnostics --file "$f" || s=1; done; exit $s; fi' --
